node.title: Total mapping classes respect the specified enriched system adjunction
node.statement:
Fix a finite-field datum $D$ with coefficient field $k$ of characteristic $p$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X,Y$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes, let $f:X\to Y$ be separated and of finite type, and fix a compactification $f=pj$ through $Z$ [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties, def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support]. Work on fixed small pro-etale skeletons [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-size-convention]. For $W=X,Y$ let $\mathscr S_W$ be the derived category of actual strict coefficient-module systems, with reduction/total-limit adjunction $\mathcal R_W\dashv\mathcal L_W$, unit $u$, counit $e$, mapping system $\mathcal H_W$ and its specified total comparison $\gamma$. Fix derived-system calculi $S_X,S_Z,S_Y$, with coherence for $S_X$ and $S_Y$ [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. Let $\mathscr N_W$ be the full category of normalized systems whose individual levels are bounded finite-Tor constructible [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower, def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude, def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility]. Fix a realization $r$ with $\mathcal F:\mathscr N_X\rightleftarrows\mathscr N_Y:\mathcal G$ and adjunction $\mathcal F\dashv\mathcal G$, geometry $g$, sections comparison $s$, system symmetries, and the specified enriched isomorphism $a$ [def-coef-finite-adjunction-system-data, def-sf-finite-adjunction-diagram-data].

For a system $U\in\mathscr S_W$ with invertible $e_U$, normalized $N\in\mathscr S_W$ and an actual arrow $b:U\to N$, define its total mapping class by the explicit formula
$$\operatorname{cl}_{S_W}(b)=H^0\!\left(R\!\lim\mathcal H_W(e_U^{-1},1)\circ\gamma_{\mathcal L_W U,N}\right)\left([\mathcal L_W(b)]\right)\in H^0\!\left(R\!\lim\mathcal H_W(U,N)\right),$$
where $[\mathcal L_W(b)]$ is the integral global-Hom class corresponding to $\mathcal L_W(b)$ under the recorded $H^0R\operatorname{Hom}$ identification [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. For arbitrary $P\in\mathscr N_X$ and $Q\in\mathscr N_Y$, suppose $e_P$ and $e_{\mathcal F P}$ are invertible. Then for every $b:\mathcal F P\to Q$,
$$H^0\!\left(R\!\lim(a_{P,Q})\right)\left(\operatorname{cl}_{S_Y}(b)\right)=\operatorname{cl}_{S_X}\left(\operatorname{adj}_r(b)\right).$$
The equation is on total mapping classes of actual system arrows; it does not assume equality of maps from their finite evaluations.

lean.statement:
theorem systemTotalEnrichedTranspose
    (CX : CoefficientDerivedSystemCoherence l E X SX)
    (CY : CoefficientDerivedSystemCoherence l E Y SY)
    (g : Geometry l E f SX SY) (s : SectionsPush g)
    (βX : @SymmetricCategory (coefficientSequenceDerived l E X) _ SX.systemClosed.monoidal)
    (βY : @SymmetricCategory (coefficientSequenceDerived l E Y) _ SY.systemClosed.monoidal)
    (a : Enriched r g s βX βY)
    (P : (domain l E X).FullSubcategory) (Q : (domain l E Y).FullSubcategory)
    [IsIso (SY.adjunction.counit.app (r.F.obj P).obj)]
    [IsIso (SX.adjunction.counit.app P.obj)] (b : r.F.obj P ⟶ Q) :
    (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u+1} 0).map
      (coefficientMappingLimit.{u+1}.map (a.iso.hom.app (op P, Q)))
        (totalHom SY (r.F.obj P).obj Q.obj Q.property.1 b.hom) =
      totalHom SX P.obj (r.G.obj Q).obj (r.G.obj Q).property.1
        (r.adjunction.homEquiv P Q b).hom

node.title: The specified integral exceptional adjunction is the descended system adjunction
node.statement:
Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $R=\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi$, and put $A_n=R/\varpi^n$ for $n\ge1$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a separated finite-type morphism of separated finite-type $k$-schemes, with a fixed compactification $f=pj$, $j$ open and $p$ proper [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties, def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support]. Work on fixed small pro-etale skeletons [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-size-convention]. For $W=X,Y$ use the category $\mathscr S_W$ of strict semilinear $((A_n)_W)_n$-module systems, its unbounded derived category, the reduction/total-limit adjunction $\mathcal R_W\dashv\mathcal L_W$ with actual unit $u$ and actual counit $e$, and the mapping systems $\mathcal H_W$ [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. Let $\mathscr N_W$ be the full subcategory of normalized systems (all transition-adjoints $N_m\otimes^L_{A_m}A_n\to N_n$, $m\ge n$, invertible) whose levels lie in $D^b_{ctf}(W,A_n)$ [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower, def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude, def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility]. Let $\mathcal F_f:\mathscr N_X\rightleftarrows\mathscr N_Y:\mathcal E_f$ be the functorial system realizations of the finite compact-support and exceptional functors, with their specified enriched system adjunction $\mathcal A$ and its counit $\epsilon^{\rm sys}$ [lem-coef-finite-adjunction-diagram-realization]. Write $\mathcal C(W)=D^b_c(W,R)$ for the derived-complete bounded constructible category over the completed coefficient sheaf [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients, def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed].

Let $F=Rf_!\dashv G=Rf^!$ be the specified adjunction on $\mathcal C(X),\mathcal C(Y)$ of [prop-coef-integral-exceptional-adjoint], with counit $\epsilon$; as functors $F=\mathcal L_Y\mathcal F_f\mathcal R_X$ and $G=\mathcal L_X\mathcal E_f\mathcal R_Y$. For $M\in\mathcal C(Y)$ put $N=\mathcal R_YM$. Then $N\in\mathscr N_Y$, $\mathcal E_fN\in\mathscr N_X$, the counit $e_{\mathcal E_fN}$ and the unit $u_M$ are isomorphisms, and
$$\kappa_M=\mathcal L_Y\mathcal F_f(e_{\mathcal E_fN}):FGM=\mathcal L_Y\mathcal F_f\mathcal R_X\mathcal L_X\mathcal E_fN\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal L_Y\mathcal F_f\mathcal E_fN$$
satisfies
$$\epsilon_M=u_M^{-1}\circ\mathcal L_Y(\epsilon^{\rm sys}_N)\circ\kappa_M .$$
Equivalently, the adjunction $F\dashv G$ of [prop-coef-integral-exceptional-adjoint], defined through the total limit of the finite mapping-complex adjunctions, is exactly the restriction to $\mathcal C(X),\mathcal C(Y)$ of the adjunction $\mathcal L_Y\mathcal F_f\mathcal R_X\dashv\mathcal L_X\mathcal E_f\mathcal R_Y$ descended from $\mathcal F_f\dashv\mathcal E_f$ through the actual unit and counit of $\mathcal R\dashv\mathcal L$ in [lem-pur-normalized-reconstruction-adjunction-calculus]: its unit and counit equal the descended ones, and its Hom bijection is the descended bijection. This is an equality of the specified natural integral maps, not inferred from equality of their finite reductions. It includes the identity morphism $f$, the zero object and empty $X$ or $Y$.

proof.text: Use the existing Domains proof fields to obtain reduction membership, the system right image membership and invertible actual counits and integral unit. The full inclusion reflects the isomorphism of the actual source reconstruction counit; F and total limit preserve it, proving kappa invertible. These facts are already part of the hypotheses and require no additional residue-Tor or preservation theorem.

For v:left(K)→M put P=R_X(K), Q=R_Y(M), B=F(P), T=G(Q), and b=e_B^{-1} R_Y(v). Naturality of the target reconstruction unit and its right triangle give v u_M=L_Y(b). Hence the first factors lambda_Y and Rlim H_Y(e_B^{-1},1) in mappingMap send the integral class of v to totalHom_SY(b). Apply lem-coef-system-total-enriched-transpose to obtain totalHom_SX(adj_r(b)).

Gamma naturality in the first variable, together with R_X(u_K)=e_{R_X K}^{-1}, identifies the latter total class with gamma_X applied to the integral adjunct w of adj_r(b). Gamma naturality in its second variable and the right reconstruction triangle give lambda_{K,L_X T} followed by Rlim H_X(1,e_T)=gamma_{K,T}. Thus the remaining inverse-counit and inverse-lambda factors in mappingMap cancel, giving w. The already proved formula for descendedHom inverse sends w to L_Y(b) u_M^{-1}=v. Its injectivity identifies homMap with descendedHom. All cancellations are on the total mapping complex, before finite evaluation.

IsSpecified now identifies every adj.homEquiv with descendedHom. Adjunction.ext applied to the unit (the transpose of the identity) proves equality with descendedAdjunction, and projecting the equality gives equality of natural units and counits. Evaluate descendedHom inverse on the identity to obtain descendedCounit. Expand descendedHom on the other identity and use the target left reconstruction triangle to obtain descendedUnit. These categorical proofs impose no nonzero or nonempty hypothesis.
